title: Heavy rainfall, flood warnings up over parts of northern Luzon even as Rosal weakens
summary: PAGASA on Thursday afternoon issued heavy rainfall and flood warnings for some parts of northern Luzon even as it announced that Rosal had already weakened into a typhoon.
